Queue operator<<¶

Back to Queue API Reference

Signature¶

std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& os, const Queue& q);

What It Does¶

Prints "Queue<Kind>" followed directly by the held payload’s own operator<< output, with the payload’s self-identifying type name stripped from the front of that output first – so the kind is never printed twice. This works uniformly across all four kinds even though the payload types don’t all format themselves the same way: Series’s own operator<< deliberately qualifies itself with a pluss:: namespace prefix ("pluss::Series(..."), while Note, Timeline, and Duration’s own operator<< do not add any prefix beyond their own bare type name. Queue’s operator<< checks for both forms and strips whichever one is actually present.

Parameters¶

os (std::ostream&)

The stream to write to.

q (const Queue&)

The Queue to print.

Returns¶

os, for chaining.

Examples¶

Example 1. All four kinds, each printed through the same operator<<. None of the four outputs repeats its own type name.

pluss::Queue series_q(pluss::make_series({1.0, 2.0}));
pluss::Queue note_q(pluss::make_note({"a", "b"}));
pluss::Queue timeline_q(pluss::timeline::make("1999-04-17T21:15:23Z"));
pluss::Queue duration_q(pluss::duration::hours(2));
std::cout << "series: " << series_q << '\n';
std::cout << "note: " << note_q << '\n';
std::cout << "timeline: " << timeline_q << '\n';
std::cout << "duration: " << duration_q << '\n';

Output¶

series: Queue<Series>(shape=[2], strides=[1], dtype=float64, platform=cpu, numel=2, contiguous=true)
data=[1, 2]
note: Queue<Note>(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["a", "b"]
timeline: Queue<Timeline>(shape=[], tz=UTC)
1999-04-17 21:15:23
duration: Queue<Duration>(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1)
0 days 02:00:00.000000000

Each line leads with Queue<Kind> exactly once, immediately followed by the payload’s own formatted body – Series’s pluss:: prefix and the other three’s bare type-name prefix are both recognized and removed.

See Also¶

  • kind: the kind name this prints, available on its own without the payload’s full formatted body.
